name: basketball-pov
description: 2K-style and phone-style basketball clips (three.js, rendered headless to MP4) driven by real motion capture: v6 is a film-room clip on the approach and the dunk (rim touch, then a tomahawk), v5 reading a defender's weight (when to shoot, contact finishes), v4 anatomical skeletons in a practice gym, v3 a tweener-cross-cross step-back three from the side, v2 a behind-the-player 1v1 breakdown.
